title: Triage the source catalog into an approved source shortlist
context: Before building M2+ packs, every candidate annotation source must be triaged through the license+data-tier gate. The source catalog in PLAN.md §7 contains Priority-A (clearly-redistributable), Priority-B (verify per-source), and Priority-C (excluded) sources. This triage task applies the gate to each candidate and produces a committed shortlist of approved sources with one gate artifact per decision — this shortlist then drives which M2 packs are built.
objective: Triage all sources in the PLAN.md §7 catalog through the license+data-tier gate, producing a committed shortlist of ≥6 APPROVED sources with one gate artifact per decision, and explicit EXCLUDED records for non-commercial/controlled-access sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Every catalog source is assigned a disposition: APPROVED (open tier + permitsRedistribution: true with cited clause/URL), VERIFY-LATER, or EXCLUDED (non-commercial/controlled-access/non-redistributable).
COSMIC, Cancer Gene Census, and OncoKB are recorded as EXCLUDED (non-commercial); all controlled-access sources (dbGaP, EGA) are EXCLUDED.
Priority-B sources (GDC-open, cBioPortal, cancer hotspots, DepMap) are resolved per-source with cited terms; unresolved sources stay VERIFY-LATER (not promoted to packs).
Output is a committed shortlist with ≥6 APPROVED sources, each with a gate artifact recording which checks ran and the cited clause/URL evidence.
Document output licensed CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
resources: SPDX license list; CC0, CC-BY 4.0, public-domain, and non-commercial license terms
output: review/catalog-014-shortlist.md — committed source shortlist with ≥6 APPROVED entries and one gate artifact per decision.
